subject.title: [Bug]: browser screenshot foregrounds the target tab on headed browsers (headless-only stall fix applied unconditionally)

question: For direct-CDP profiles whose real browser mode is unknown, should screenshot capture default to preserving focus or to activation-first reliability?
rationale: Known local managed mode can be handled deterministically, but current configuration cannot establish the actual mode of remote CDP or existing-session browsers; either default has a user-visible tradeoff.

options.title: Preserve focus by default
options.body: Activate only for known-headless local managed sessions, and capture without activation for unknown remote mode unless capability metadata later proves activation is needed.

options.title: Preserve reliability by default
options.body: Skip activation only for known-headed local managed sessions while retaining activation-first capture for unknown remote mode.

options.title: Capture-first recovery
options.body: Capture without activation everywhere, then reconnect, activate, and retry only after the exact screenshot timeout within a defined total timeout budget.

recommendation.title: Preserve focus by default
recommendation.body: Activate only for known-headless local managed sessions, and capture without activation for unknown remote mode unless capability metadata later proves activation is needed.

likelyOwner.reason: They established the current intentional reliability-versus-focus contract and have the strongest available provenance for choosing its replacement default.
